## R Markdown

```{r, echo=TRUE, error=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
dat <- read.csv("Circadian_Table_S1.csv", header=T)
complete_dat<-na.omit(dat)
complete_dat$Treatment<-as.factor(complete_dat$Treatment)
```


## Test for differences beween treatments 
```{r, echo=TRUE, error=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(nlme)
complete_dat$Treatment<-relevel(complete_dat$Treatment,"Dark")
m1 <- lme(circadian_strength ~ Treatment ,random=~1|Origin/Species,data=complete_dat)
summary(m1)
complete_dat$Treatment<-relevel(complete_dat$Treatment,"LD")
m1 <- lme(circadian_strength ~ Treatment ,random=~1|Origin/Species,data=complete_dat)
summary(m1)


# test for differences in ultradian rhythm strength 
complete_dat$Treatment<-relevel(complete_dat$Treatment,"Dark")
m1 <- lme(ultradian_strength ~ Treatment ,random=~1|Origin/Species,data=complete_dat)
summary(m1)
complete_dat$Treatment<-relevel(complete_dat$Treatment,"LD")
m1 <- lme(ultradian_strength ~ Treatment ,random=~1|Origin/Species,data=complete_dat)
summary(m1)


# test for differences in the dominant period of ultradian rhythms 
complete_dat$Treatment<-relevel(complete_dat$Treatment,"Dark")
m1 <- lme(ultradian_period ~ Treatment ,random=~1|Origin/Species,data=complete_dat)
summary(m1)
complete_dat$Treatment<-relevel(complete_dat$Treatment,"LD")
m1 <- lme(ultradian_period ~ Treatment ,random=~1|Origin/Species,data=complete_dat)
summary(m1)


# test for correlation between circadian strength metrics 

dat <- read.csv('Circadian_Table_S1.csv', header=T)

cor.test(dat$circadian_strength,dat$transformed_cosinor_amplitude)

```

## Test for differences between treatments (include only colonies confirmed to have larvae)
```{r, echo=TRUE, error=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
dat <- read.csv("Circadian_Table_S1.csv", header=T)
complete_dat<-na.omit(dat)
complete_dat <- subset(complete_dat, Larvae == "Yes") 
complete_dat$Treatment<-as.factor(complete_dat$Treatment)

complete_dat$Treatment<-relevel(complete_dat$Treatment,"Dark")
m1 <- lme(circadian_strength ~ Treatment ,random=~1|Origin/Species,data=complete_dat)
summary(m1)
complete_dat$Treatment<-relevel(complete_dat$Treatment,"LD")
m1 <- lme(circadian_strength ~ Treatment ,random=~1|Origin/Species,data=complete_dat)
summary(m1)


# test for differences in ultradian rhythm strength 
complete_dat$Treatment<-relevel(complete_dat$Treatment,"Dark")
m1 <- lme(ultradian_strength ~ Treatment ,random=~1|Origin/Species,data=complete_dat)
summary(m1)
complete_dat$Treatment<-relevel(complete_dat$Treatment,"LD")
m1 <- lme(ultradian_strength ~ Treatment ,random=~1|Origin/Species,data=complete_dat)
summary(m1)


# test for differences in the dominant period of ultradian rhythms
complete_dat$Treatment<-relevel(complete_dat$Treatment,"Dark")
m1 <- lme(ultradian_period ~ Treatment ,random=~1|Origin/Species,data=complete_dat)
summary(m1)
complete_dat$Treatment<-relevel(complete_dat$Treatment,"LD")
m1 <- lme(ultradian_period ~ Treatment ,random=~1|Origin/Species,data=complete_dat)
summary(m1)
```

# This section tests for an association between the time of day in the LD treatment (day/night) and 1. the mean activity level of colonies, 2. the dominant ultradian period of colonies, and 3. the ultradian strength of colonies

```{r, echo=TRUE, error=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
LD_PP_reduce <- read.csv("Circadian_Table_S2.csv", header=T)

tlong <- subset(LD_PP_reduce, Species == "Temnothorax longispinosus")
m1 <- lme(photoactive ~ Time_of_day ,random=~1|Colony,data=tlong)
summary(m1)

tsten <- subset(LD_PP_reduce, Species == "Temnothorax stenotyle")
m1 <- lme(photoactive ~ Time_of_day ,random=~1|Colony,data=tsten)
summary(m1)

mp <- subset(LD_PP_reduce, Species == "Myrmica punctiventris")
m1 <- lme(photoactive ~ Time_of_day ,random=~1|Colony,data=mp)
summary(m1)

mea <- subset(LD_PP_reduce, Species == "Myrmecina americana")
m1 <- lme(photoactive ~ Time_of_day ,random=~1|Colony,data=mea)
summary(m1)

tsess <- subset(LD_PP_reduce, Species == "Tapinoma sessile")
m1 <- lme(photoactive ~ Time_of_day ,random=~1|Colony,data=tsess)
summary(m1)

Lcan <- subset(LD_PP_reduce, Species == "Leptothorax AF-can")
m1 <- lme(photoactive ~ Time_of_day ,random=~1|Colony,data=Lcan)
summary(m1)


# Photoperiod activity LME

m1 <- lme(photoactive ~ Time_of_day ,random=~1|Species/Colony,data=LD_PP_reduce)
summary(m1)


# Photoperiod ultradian period LME

m1 <- lme(periodpp_rescaled ~ Time_of_day ,random=~1|Species/Colony,data=LD_PP_reduce)
summary(m1)


# Photoperiod ultradian rhythm strength LME

m1 <- lme(waveletpp_rescaled ~ Time_of_day ,random=~1|Species/Colony,data=LD_PP_reduce)
summary(m1)
```
